description: This Java source file defines the 'LanguageMask' class, which implements a bitmask to specify programming languages (Java and Native/C) for code generation. It includes constants for Java and Native masks, predefined masks for 'NATIVE' and 'JAVA', and methods to add languages, check if a language is included, and reset the mask.

classes.name: LanguageMask
classes.description: A class that manages a bitmask representing programming languages for code generation, allowing adding languages, checking for the presence of specific languages, and resetting the mask.

methods.name: addJava
methods.description: Adds Java to the language mask.

methods.name: hasJava
methods.description: Checks if Java is included in the current language mask.

methods.name: addNative
methods.description: Adds Native (C) to the language mask.

methods.name: hasNative
methods.description: Checks if Native (C) is included in the current language mask.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the language mask to zero, removing all languages.
